title: Burnham announces £65m for drought-hit farmers after Labour pressure

paragraphs.en: Farmers must not carry the risks of the climate crisis alone, Andy Burnham has said, as he announced £65m of funding to help them manage the devastating drought.
paragraphs.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆表示，农民绝不能独自承担气候危机的风险，他同时宣布提供6500万英镑的资金，帮助他们应对这场灾难性的干旱。

paragraphs.en: The prime minister is stepping up his response to the immediate climate crisis after facing a backlash from his own MPs and Labour’s grassroots for not addressing the climate crisis despite wildfires tearing through Britain and a drought affecting food producers. Labour MPs argued Burnham had taken too long to talk about the climate crisis and had not made it a priority.
paragraphs.zh: 在面临本党议员和工党基层的强烈反弹之后，这位首相正在加大对当前气候危机的应对力度。此前，尽管野火席卷英国、干旱影响到食品生产商，他却没有针对气候危机发声。工党议员认为，伯纳姆在谈论气候危机问题上反应太慢，没有将其列为优先事项。

paragraphs.en: Some farmers have had to harvest their crops early, while others are seeing low-quality produce and low yields . Most of the £65m will go to the sustainable farming incentive (SFI), which pays farmers in England to support nature. Officials have said this extra £50m will bring the total SFI budget to £290m, with extra money prioritised for areas of greatest need during the drought.
paragraphs.zh: 一些农民不得不提前收割庄稼，另一些农民则面临农产品品质低下和产量下降。这笔6500万英镑的大部分将投入可持续农业激励计划（SFI），该计划向英格兰的农民提供资金，以支持他们保护自然。官员们表示，这笔额外的5000万英镑将使SFI的总预算达到2.9亿英镑，额外资金将优先用于干旱期间需求最迫切的地区。

paragraphs.en: Burnham chaired a Cobra meeting on extreme heat , wildfires and drought this week. Downing Street is seeking to establish a cross-government response to the drought, bringing together action on farming, water and infrastructure, including more flexibility for food producers. Farmers who are paid to look after nature on parts of their land and are usually barred from cutting or grazing it until later in the year are now able to do so where grass is scarce, without losing payments.
paragraphs.zh: 本周，伯纳姆主持了一场关于极端高温、野火和干旱的“眼镜蛇”紧急会议。唐宁街正寻求建立跨部门的干旱应对机制，统筹农业、水资源和基础设施方面的行动，包括为食品生产商提供更多灵活性。那些受资助在部分土地上照护自然、通常要到下半年才能割草或放牧的农民，如今在牧草稀缺的情况下可以提前进行，而不会损失补贴。

paragraphs.en: Farmers will also get £15m in support for building on-farm reservoirs to provide supplies during future dry summers. However, campaigners have warned this £15m is reallocated money from existing funds and will only fund a “fraction” of reservoirs needed. They will get improved access to water through simpler arrangements around how much they can take from the environment and changes to the speed at which licences are given, making it easier for farmers to use water where it is most needed.
paragraphs.zh: 农民还将获得1500万英镑的支持，用于修建农场内水库，以便在未来的干旱夏季供水。然而，活动人士警告说，这1500万英镑是从现有资金中重新划拨的，只能建成所需水库的“一小部分”。农民将通过更简化的取水安排和更快的许可证发放速度，获得更好的用水渠道，使农民更容易在最需要的地方用水。

paragraphs.en: Burnham is to visit a farm in the south-west of England on Saturday and is expected to say: “ I am meeting with farmers here in the south-west who brought in the earliest harvest of their working lives and watched the yield come in well down on what it should be. Lower income, higher costs and no rain in the forecast. I understand the worry that comes with that.
paragraphs.zh: 伯纳姆将于周六前往英格兰西南部的一个农场视察，预计他会说：“我正在西南部与这里的农民会面，他们经历了职业生涯中最早的收获季，眼看着产量远低于应有的水平。收入下降、成本上升，预报里又没有雨。我理解随之而来的忧虑。”

paragraphs.en: “The ability to grow our own food is national security and I will treat it that way. So we are acting now: more money into farm support, help to get reservoirs built and easier access to water when it is scarce.
paragraphs.zh: “我们自己种植粮食的能力事关国家安全，我会以这样的态度对待它。所以我们现在就要行动：为农业支持投入更多资金，帮助修建水库，在水资源短缺时让取水更加便利。”

paragraphs.en: “This is the third drought in five years. Farmers are at the sharp end of a changing climate and they should not be carrying that risk alone.”
paragraphs.zh: “这是五年内的第三次干旱。农民处在气候变化的刀口浪尖上，他们不应独自承担这份风险。”
